raw_plan.root_cause: A fixed 16-byte heap buffer is allocated with malloc(16), but memcpy copies strlen(input)+1 bytes into it without checking that the input length fits within the 16-byte capacity, so inputs of length 16 or more overflow the heap allocation.
affected_memory: heap buffer returned by malloc(16) at [rbp-8]
raw_plan.original_behavior: Allocates 16 bytes via malloc, exits(1) if allocation fails, computes strlen(input)+1, copies that many bytes from input into the 16-byte buffer via memcpy, then calls puts on the buffer and frees it, returning normally.
raw_plan.required_invariant: The number of bytes copied into the 16-byte heap buffer must be at most 16, i.e. strlen(input)+1 <= 16, so the copy never writes past the allocation.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: After computing strlen(input)+1, compare the length against the 16-byte capacity; if it exceeds capacity, reject the input by calling exit(1) (or otherwise fail safely) before performing memcpy. For valid inputs (length+1 <= 16), perform the memcpy, puts, and free exactly as before, preserving observable behavior.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: On oversized input (strlen(input)+1 > 16), terminate via exit(1) without performing the overflowing memcpy; on malloc failure, exit(1) as originally.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For inputs whose length plus NUL fits in 16 bytes, allocate, copy, print, and free the buffer, returning normally with identical output. For inputs that would overflow, exit(1) instead of corrupting the heap.
verification_conditions: Inputs of length 0..15 produce the same puts output as the original and return normally
Input of length 16 or greater does not write beyond the 16-byte allocation and terminates via exit(1)
malloc failure path still calls exit(1)

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
